items.label: Mini PlenishIV (Mini Myers-style)
items.note: Half of the standard PlenishIV dose; preparation and administration instructions must be verified.

items.label: Full PlenishIV (Myers-style)
items.note: Standard PlenishIV product; Myers-style is a familiar descriptive search term, not a separate formulation.

approval_requirements: Exact formulation, concentrations, diluent, volume and route
Documented physical/chemical compatibility for same-bag or Y-site administration
Maximum total cumulative doses and infusion rate
Patient-specific contraindication, medication and laboratory screening
Pharmacist/medical-director review, source citation, effective date and version
notes: No pairs are authorized by this draft policy.
Separate administration does not imply clinical suitability.
Public display must not disclose patient information.
All clinical blocks must be enforced by the server, not only the browser.
